_source.chapter: The Amount of Charity to be Given
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَبذُلْ لإِخوانِكَ مِن نفسِكَ ما ضَرُّهُ علَيكَ أكثَرُ مِن مَنفَعَتِهِ لَهُم.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Do not give away of yourself to your brothers so much that the loss incurred by you supercedes the benefit to them.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ليسَ المِسكينُ بالطَّوّافِ، ولا بِالذي تَرُدُّهُ التَّمرَةُ والتَّمرَتانِ، واللُّقمَةُ واللُّقمَتانِ، ولكنَّ المِسكينَ المُتَعَفِّفُ الذي لا يَسألُ الناسَ شيئاً ولا يُفطَنُ لَهُ فَيُتَصَدَّقُ علَيهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The one who is truly poor does not roam around the streets begging, nor can he be turned away with a date or two, or a bite or two. Rather the one who is truly poor is he who restrains himself from asking people and who does not draw attention to himself, that is the one that should be given charity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لمّا سُئلَ عنِ الصَّدَقةِ على مَن يَسألُ على الأبوابِ، أو يُمسِكُ ذلكَ عَنهُم ويُعطِيهِ ذَوِي قَرابَتِهِ ؟ ـ: لا، بل يَبعَثُ بها إلى مَن بينَهُ وبينَهُ قَرابَةٌ، فهذا أعظَمُ لِلأجرِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) was once asked whether one should give charity to those who beg at peoples doors, or whether to withhold it from them and give it to ones poor relatives instead, to which he replied, ‘No, rather one should send it to a [poor] relative, for that holds a greater reward.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ أيضا ـ: المَحرومُ المُحارَفُ الذي قد حُرِمَ كَدَّ يَدِهِ في الشِّراءِ والبَيعِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said with regards to Allahs verse in the Quran: “…the beggar and the deprived”, ‘The deprived is the disabled one who is deprived of the use of his hands for working in trade.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): تَصَدَّقُوا مِن غَيرِ مَخِيلَةٍ؛ فإنَّ المَخِيلَةَ تُبطِلُ الأجرَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Give in charity without conceitedness, for verily conceitedness does away with your reward [for it].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): المَطلُ والمَنُّ مُنَكِّداً الإحسانِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Delaying [ones promise of] giving and reproaching someone for a gift embitters the goodness of the favor.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): حُسْنُ البِشْرِ يَذهَبُ بالسَّخِيمةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Cheerfulness removes the grudge [of others].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اِلْقَ أخاكَ بِوَجْهٍ مُنْبَسِطٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Meet your brother with a cheerful face.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّكُم لَن تَسَعُوا النّاسَ بأموالِكُم، فالْقُوهُم بِطَلاقةِ الوَجهِ وحُسْنِ البِشرِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘You will not be able to encompass all people with your money, so meet them with cheerful faces and joy.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): البَشاشَةُ حِبالَةُ المَوَدّةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The smile is the trap of amity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): البِشرُ شِيمةُ الحُرِّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Cheerfulness is the trait of the free.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سَببُ المَحبّةِ البِشرُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The cause of love is cheerfulness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ بِشرَ المؤمنِ في وَجهِهِ، وقُوّتَهُ في دِينِهِ، وحُزنَهُ في قَلبِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The cheerfulness of the believer is on his face, his strength is in his religion, and his sorrow lies in his heart.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): بِشرُكَ يدُلُّ على كَرَمِ نفسِكَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Your cheerfulness shows the generosity of your soul.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا لَقِيتُم إخْوانَكُم فَتَصافَحوا، وأظْهِروا لَهمُ البَشاشَةَ والبِشرَ، تَتَفَرّقوا وما علَيكُمْ مِن الأوْزارِ قد ذَهبَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘When you meet your brothers, shake hands with them and show them cheerfulness and joy; thus when you part company all your sins will have gone.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ أحْسنَ ما يَأْلَفُ بهِ النّاسُ قلوبَ أوِدّائهِم، ونَفَوا بهِ الضِّغْنَ عن قُلوبِ أعْدائهِم: حُسنُ البِشرِ عند لِقائهِم، والتَّفَقُّدُ في غَيبتِهم، والبَشاشةُ بِهم عند حُضورِهِم.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The best thing with which people can win the hearts of their loved ones and remove the animosity from the hearts of their enemies is cheerfulness upon meeting, asking about them in their absence, and smiling at them in their presence.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سَيِّدُ القَومِ خادِمُهُم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The chief of a people should serve them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سَألَهُ أبوهُ عنِ السُّؤدُدِ ـ: إحشاشُ العَشِيرَةِ ، واحتِمالُ الجَرِيرَةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) when asked by his father about what chiefdom involves, replied, '[The ability] To make one's tribe flourish, and [the capacity] to bear the burden of their crimes.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): بِاحتِمالِ المُؤَنِ يَجِبُ السُّؤدُدُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Chiefdom is achieved through tolerating hardships.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الشَّريفُ كُلُّ الشَّريفِ مَن شَرَّفَهُ عِلمُهُ ، والسُّؤدُدُ حَقُّ السُّؤدُدِ لِمَنِ اتَّقى اللّهَ رَبَّهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The truly noble one is he who has been ennobled by his knowledge, and true chiefdom belongs to he who is wary of his duty to Allah, his Lord.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فَضيلَةُ السادَةِ حُسنُ العِبادَةِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ' The virtue characteristic of chiefs is the beauty of their worship.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أربَعُ خِصالٍ يَسُودُ بِها المَرءُ: العِفَّةُ ، والأدَبُ ، والجُودُ ، والعَقلُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'There are four virtues that qualify a man for chiefdom: chastity, courtesy, magnanimity and intelligence.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الإعطاءُ قَبلَ السُّؤالِ مِن أكبَرِ السُّؤدُدِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said, 'The greatest characteristic of chiefdom is giving before one is asked.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مُنازَعَةُ السُّفَّلِ تَشِينُ السّادَةَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Engaging in disputes with the lower classes is a source of disgrace for chiefs.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَطمَعَنَّ... المُعاقِبُ على الذَنبِ الصغيرِ في السُّؤدُدِ ، ولا القَليلُ التَّجرِبَةِ المُعجَبُ بِرَأيِهِ في رئاسَةٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'The person guilty of petty sins should not be coveting chiefdom, and neither should the inexperienced person who proudly holds his own opinion be coveting leadership.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَسودُ سَفِيهٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'A fool can never be chief.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): عَرامَةُ الصَّبيِّ في صِغَرِهِ زِيادَةٌ في عَقلِهِ في كِبَرِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Chiding a boy in his childhood [as discipline] leads to an increase in his intellect as an adult.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن لم يُجهِدْ نَفسَهُ في صِغَرِهِ لَم يَنبُلْ في كِبَرِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who does not exert himself in his childhood will not be high-minded when he grows up.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن سَألَ في صِغَرِهِ أجابَ في كِبَرِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who asks questions as a child is able to answer them himself as an adult.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن لَم يَتَعَلَّمْ في الصِّغَرِ لَم يَتَقَدَّمْ في الكِبَرِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who does not learn as a child does not progress as an adult.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الجاهِلُ صَغيرٌ وإن كانَ شَيخاً، والعالِمُ كَبيرٌ وإن كانَ حَدَثاً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The ignorant man is a child even though he may be old, while the knowledgeable man is an adult even though he be young.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تُستَحَبُّ عَرامَةُ الغُلامِ في صِغَرِهِ لِيَكُونَ حَليماً في كِبَرِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘It is recommended to discipline a boy in his childhood in order that he be clement as an adult.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : كادَ الحَليمُ أنْ يَكونَ نَبِيّاً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The clement person is almost a prophet.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِلمُ تَمامُ العَقلِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Clemency is the completion of the intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِلمُ نِظامُ أمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Clemency arranges the affair of the believer.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : جَمالُ الرّجُلِ حِلمُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The beauty of a man is his clemency.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنْ لَم تَكُن حَليما فَتَحَلَّمْ ؛ فإنَّهُ قَلَّ مَن تَشبَّهَ بقَومٍ إلّا أوْشَكَ أنْ يكونَ مِنهُم.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘If you are not of the clement ones then feign clemency for verily few people who imitate a group fail to become one of them.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحَليمُ مَنِ احْتَمَلَ إخوانَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The clement one is he who tolerates his brother.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا يَكونُ الرّجُلُ عابِداً حتّى يكونَ حَليماً.
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS), ‘A man cannot be a worshipper until he is clement.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : بِوُفورِ العقلِ يَتَوفّرُ الحِلمُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘With the profusion of the intellect, clemency flourishes.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : علَيكَ بالحِلمِ ؛ فإنّهُ ثمَرَةُ العِلمِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Incumbent upon you is clemency for verily it is the fruit of knowledge.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِلمُ والأناةُ تَوْأمانِ يُنْتِجُهما عُلُوُّ الهِمَّةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Clemency and forbearance are two twins that produce great resolution.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن حَلُمَ سادَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘One who is clement has the upper hand.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن حَلُمَ عن عَدُوِّهِ ظَفِرَ بهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘One who is clement with his enemy is victorious.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنّ أوّلَ عِوَضِ الحَليمِ مِن خَصْلَتِهِ ، أنّ الناسَ أعْوانُهُ على الجاهِلِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the first recompense from the qualities of the clement person is that the people will assist him against the ignorant one.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحِلمُ عِندَ شِدَّةِ الغَضَبِ يُؤمِنُ غَضَبَ الجَبّارِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Clemency in the midst of severe anger will protect one from the anger of the Almighty.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كفى بالحِلمِ ناصِراً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Clemency suffices as a helper.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد سُئلَ عنِ الحِلْمِ ـ : كَظْمُ الغَيظِ ومِلْكُ النَّفْسِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS), when asked about clemency, said, ‘[It is] suppressing ones anger and controlling oneself.

_source.arabic: لقمانُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا يُعْرَفُ الحَليمُ إلّا عِندَ الغَضَبِ.
_source.english: Luqman (AS) said, ‘The clement person is unknown until he is angered.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لمّا سُئلَ عن أحلَمِ النّاسِ ـ : الّذي لا يَغْضَبُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS), when asked about the most clement person, said, ‘The one who does not become enraged.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنّهُ لَيُعْجِبُني الرّجُلُ أنْ يُدرِكَهُ حِلمُهُ عِندَ غَضَبِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘The man who finds his clemency in the midst of his anger amazes me.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن وَثِقَ بأنَّ ما قَدَّرَ اللّهُ لَهُ لَن يَفُوتَهُ اسْتَراحَ قَلبُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'He who has confidence in the fact that whatever sustenance Allah has apportioned for him will definitely reach him has secured comfort for his heart.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الزَّوجةُ المُوافِقَةُ إحدَى الراحَتَينِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'A compatible wife is one of the two main comforts.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَنِ اقتَصَرَ على بُلغَةِ الكَفافِ فَقَدِ انتَظَمَ الراحَةَ ، وتَبَوَّأ خَفضَ الدَّعَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'He who restricts himself to what is just sufficient for maintenance has secured comfort and leads a carefree life.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الزُّهدُ في الدنيا الراحَةُ العُظمى.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The greatest comfort lies in practicing abstemiousness in this world.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الرَّوْحُ والرّاحَةُ في الرِّضا واليَقينِ ، والهَمُّ والحَزَنُ في الشَكِّ والسَّخَطِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Tranquility and comfort lie in satisfaction and certainty, whereas worry and sorrow lie in doubt and dissatisfaction.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أروَحُ الرَّوْحِ اليَأسُ عنِ الناسِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Absolute tranquility lies in despairing of [any favours from] people.

_source.arabic: عن الإمام الصادق (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لأصحابِهِ ـ: لا تَتَمَنَّوا المُستَحِيلَ ، قالوا: ومَن يَتَمَنَّى المُستَحيلَ؟! فقالَ: أنتُم، ألَستُم تَمَنَّونَ الراحَةَ في الدنيا ؟! قالوا: بَلى ، فقالَ: الراحَةُ للمُؤمِنِ في الدنيا مُستَحيلَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, addressing his companions, 'Do not wish for the impossible. They retorted, 'Who ever wishes for the impossible?' to which he replied, 'You do. Do you not wish for comfort in this world?' They replied, 'Yes', so he (AS) said, 'Comfort is impossible for the believer to secure in this world.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَعرَّضوا للتِّجاراتِ، فإنّ لَكُم فيها غِنىً عمّا في أيْدي النّاسِ، وإنّ اللّهَ عزّ وجلّ يُحِبُّ المُحتَرِفَ الأمينَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Practice the various trades, for there is in them independence for you from what is in the hands of others, and indeed Allah loves the one gainfully engaged in a profession.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): التِّجارةُ تَزيدُ في العقلِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Trading enhances the intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَرْكُ التّجارةِ يَنْقُصُ العقلَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Abandoning trading diminishes the intellect.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد قالَ لَهُ مُعاذُ بنُ كثيرٍ بَيّاعُ الأكْسِيَةِ: إنّي قد هَمَمْتُ أنْ أدَعَ السُّوقَ وفي يَدي شَيءٌ ـ: إذَنْ يَسْقُطَ رأيُكَ ولا يُسْتعانَ بكَ على شيءٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS), when the clothes merchant, Muadh ben Kathir told him, ‘I intend to leave the market while I have some money in hand, said, ‘Then regard for you will fall and you will not be sought for help with anything.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن باعَ واشْتَرى فلْيَجْتَنِبْ خَمسَ خِصالٍ، وإلّا فلا يَبيعَنَّ ولا يَشْتَرِيَنَّ: الرِّبا، والحَلْفَ، وكِتْمانَ العَيبِ، والحمدَ إذا باعَ، والذَّمَّ إذا اشْتَرى.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever sells or buys must avoid five habits, or he should not sell or buy at all: usury, [false] oaths, hiding the defects [of merchandise], praising what he sells, and showing disapproval for what he intends to buy.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): التّاجرُ الجَبانُ مَحرومٌ، والتّاجرُ الجَسورُ مَرزوقٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The timid merchant is often deprived and the bold merchant is often endowed with profit.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا مَعشَر التُّجّارِ، الفِقْهَ ثُمّ المَتْجَرَ، الفِقْهَ ثُمّ المَتْجَرَ، الفِقْهَ ثُمّ المَتْجَرَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘O merchants! Knowledge [of trading laws and ethics] first, then the trade itself! Knowledge first, then trade! Knowledge first, then trade!

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا مَعشرَ التُّجّارِ، قَدِّموا الاسْتِخارةَ، وتَبرَّكوا بالسُّهولةِ، واقتَرِبوا مِن المُبْتاعِينَ، وتَزَيَّنوا بالحِلْمِ، وتَناهَوا عن اليَمينِ، وجانِبوا الكَذِبَ، وتَخافوا (تَجافَوا) عنِ الظُّلْمِ، وأنْصِفوا المظلومِينَ، ولا تَقْرَبوا الرِّبا، وأوْفُوا الكَيْلَ والمِيزانَ، ولا تَبْخَسوا النّاسَ أشياءهُم، ولاتَعْثَوا في الأرضِ مُفسدينَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘O merchants! Start off by seeking a good outcome from Allah, seek the blessing in easy conduct, draw near to customers, beautify yourselves with clemency, refrain from oaths, abandon lies, avoid wronging, be fair to those being wronged, stay away from usury, and “Observe fully the measure and the balance, with justice, and do not cheat the people of their goods, and do not act wickedly on the earth, causing corruption”

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أرادَ التّجارةَ فلْيَتَفقَّهْ في دِينِهِ لِيَعلمَ بذلكَ ما يَحِلُّ لَهُ مِمّا يَحْرُمُ علَيهِ، ومَن لَم يَتَفقّهْ في دِينِهِ ثُمّ اتّجَرَ تَورَّطَ الشُّبُهاتِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever wants to trade must learn his religion thoroughly in order to know what is allowed and what is forbidden for him; and whoever does not learn about his religion and then practice trading will certainly get entangled into uncertainties.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أيُّما مسلِمٍ أقالَ مسلِماً بَيعَ نَدامَةٍ أقالَهُ اللّهُ عزّ وجلّ عَثْرتَهُ يَومَ القيامةِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Any Muslim who excuses another Muslim for a regrettable deal, Allah, the Exalted, will forgive his lapse on the Day of Judgment.

_source.chapter: The Prohibition Of Cheating [By Giving Less Than Due] In Trade
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا وَزَنْتُم فأرْجِحوا.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘When you weigh, tip the balance [in favor of the customer].

_source.chapter: The Prohibition Of Cheating [By Giving Less Than Due] In Trade
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) :لا يكونُ الوفاءُ حتّى يَميلَ المِيزانُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The deal is not fulfilled until the balance is tipped [in favor of the customer].

_source.chapter: Enjoinment Upon The Trader To Give Charity
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يا مَعشرَ التُّجّارِ، إنَّ هذا البَيْعَ يَحضُرُهُ اللّغوُ والحَلفُ، فَشُوبُوهُ بالصّدَقةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘O merchants! Satan and sin are always present during the trade, so mix your trades with charity.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): رَحِمَ اللّهُ عبداً سَمْحاً إذا باعَ، سَمْحاً إذا اشْتَرى، سَمحاً إذا قضى، سَمحاً إذا اقْتَضى.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘May Allah bestow mercy on someone who is liberal when he sells, when he buys, when he judges, and when he is judged.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لِرجُلٍ يُوصيهِ ومَعهُ سِلْعَةٌ يَبيعُها ـ: سَمِعْتُ رسولَ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) يقولُ: السَّماحُ وَجهٌ مِن الرِّباحِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) once admonished a man who was selling something, ‘I heard the Prophet (SAWA) saying, ‘Leniency is one way to profit.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يا عليُّ، لا تُماكِسْ في أربَعةِ أشياءَ: في شِراءِ الاُضْحِيّةِ، والكفَنِ، والنَّسَمةِ، والكَرْيِ إلى مَكّةَ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘O Ali! Do not bargain for four things: when selling the sacrificial animal [for the obligatory pilgrimage], the shroud, the servant, and transportation to Makkah.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ماكِسِ المُشْتَري ، فإنَّهُ أطيَبُ للنّفْسِ وإنْ أعطى الجَزيلَ ، فإنّ المَغبونَ في بَيعِهِ وشِرائِهِ غيرُ مَحمودٍ ولا مَأجورٍ
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Bargain with the buyer, even if he makes a generous offer, for the loser in selling or buying is neither praised, nor rewarded.

_source.chapter: Equality Between One Who Bargains And One Who Does Not
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في رجُلٍ عِندَهُ بَيْعٌ، فَسَعّرَهُ سِعْراً مَعلوماً، فمَنْ سَكَتَ عنهُ مِمّنْ يَشْتري مِنهُ باعَهُ بذلكَ السِّعْرِ، ومَن ماكَسَهُ وأبى أنْ يَبْتاعَ مِنهُ زادَهُ ـ: لو كانَ يَزيدُ الرَّجُلَينِ والثَّلاثةَ لم يَكُنْ بذلكَ بَأسٌ، فأمَّا أنْ يَفعَلَهُ بمَن أبى علَيهِ وكايَسَهُ ويَمْنَعَهُ مِمَّن لَم يَفْعَلْ ذلك فلا يُعْجِبُني إلّا أنْ يَبيعَهُ بَيْعاً واحِداً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said regarding a man who has a commodity and marks it for sale at a certain price; he would sell it to any silent buyer for the marked price, but he would make a better offer for the bargainer: ‘If he were to make a better offer for two or three men, it would not be a problem; but if he does that for everyone who bargains with him and not for non-bargainers, his deed would not appeal to me. He must be singular in his sale.

_source.chapter: The Profit Of A Believer From Another
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رِبْحُ المؤمنِ على المؤمنِ رِبا، إلّا أنْ يَشْتريَ بأكْثَرَ مِن مائةِ دِرْهَمٍ فاربَحْ علَيهِ قُوتَ يَومِكَ، أو يَشْتَرِيَهُ للتِّجارةِ فارْبَحُوا علَيهِم وارْفُقوا بهِم.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The profit of a believer from another is usury, unless he buys with more than one hundred dirhams, whereupon you can profit as much as your days sustenance; or if he buys it for trading, then you can profit, but be moderate with them.

_source.chapter: The Profit Of A Believer From Another
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد سُئلَ عنِ الخَبَرِ الّذي رُويَ أنّ رِبْحَ المؤمنِ على المؤمنِ رِبا، ما هُو ؟ ـ: ذاكَ إذا ظَهرَ الحقُّ وقامَ قائمُنا أهلَ البيتِ، فأمّا اليومَ فلا بأسَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS), when he was asked about the statement: ‘The profit of a believer from another is usury, replied, ‘That is when equity prevails, and our Qaim [i.e. the Mahdi] appears; but for now, it does not matter.

_source.arabic: رسول اللّه (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ التُّجّارَ هُمُ الفُجّارُ. قالوا: يا رسولَ اللّهِ، أليسَ قد أحلَّ اللّهُ البَيْعَ؟ قالَ: بلى، ولكنَّهُم يُحَدِّثونَ فيَكْذِبونَ، ويَحْلِفونَ فيَأثَمونَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily the merchants are the debauchers. They asked, ‘O Messenger of Allah! But has Allah not made trading lawful? He said, ‘Yes, but they lie when they speak, and they take [false] oaths and incur sins.

_source.arabic: كان عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) يَجيء إلى السُّوقِ فيقومُ مَقاما له، فيقولُ: السّلامُ عليكم أهلَ السُّوقِ، اتَّقوا اللّهَ في الحَلْفِ، فإنّ الحَلفَ يُزجي السِّلْعَةَ ويَمْحَقُ البَرَكةَ، التّاجرُ فاجرٌ إلّا مَن أخذَ الحقَّ وأعْطاهُ .
_source.english: It is narrated in Kanz al-Ummal: ‘Ali used to go to the market and stand in his usual place to say, ‘Peace be upon you, O people of the market! Fear Allah in your oaths, for the oath degrades the commodity and drives away the blessing. The merchant is iniquitous except for he who takes and gives only what is right.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): التّاجرُ الأمينُ الصَّدوقُ المسلِمُ معَ الشّهداءِ يَومَ القيامةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The trustworthy honest Muslim merchant will be with the martyrs on the Day of Judgment.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): التّاجرُ الصّدوقُ تحتَ ظِلِّ العَرشِ يَومَ القيامةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The honest merchant will be in the shade of the Throne on the Day of Judgment.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ثلاثةٌ لا يَنْظُرُ اللّهُ إلَيهِم ... والمُزَكّي سِلْعَتَهُ بالكَذِبِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA), ‘Three types of men at whom Allah will not look [mercifully]: … and the one who promotes his commodity by lying.

_source.chapter: The One Who Promotes His Commodity By Oaths
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا مَعاشرَ السَّماسِرَةِ، أقِلّوا الأيْمانَ، فإنّها مَنفَقَةٌ للسِّلْعَةِ، مَمْحَقَةٌ للرِّبْحِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘O brokers! Curb your use of oaths, for they promote the commodity while obliterating the profit.

_source.chapter: The One Who Promotes His Commodity By Oaths
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّهَ تباركَ وتعالى لَيُبْغِضُ المُنَفِّق سِلْعتَهُ بالأيْمانِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Allah, Blessed and most High, loathes the one who promotes his commodity by oaths.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): كلُّ ما أبْصَرْتَهُ بعَينِكَ واسْتَحْلاهُ قلبُكَ فاجعَلْهُ للّهِ، فذلكَ تِجارةُ الآخِرَةِ، لأنَّ اللّهَ يقولُ: «ما عِندَكُم يَنْفَدُ وماعِندَ اللّهِ باقٍ».
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘All that you see with your own eye and that your heart finds pleasing, make it for Allah, for this is the trade of the Hereafter. Allah says, “What is with you depletes, while what is with Allah is eternal”.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): تاجِرُ الدُّنيا مُخاطِرٌ بنفسِهِ ومالِهِ، وتاجِرُ الآخِرَةِ غانِمٌ رابِحٌ، وأوَّلُ رِبْحهِ نَفسُهُ ثُمَّ جَنّةُ المَأوى.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The merchant of this world risks his money and and his soul, while the merchant of the Hereafter is a profiting winner: his first profit is his soul and then the eternal Paradise.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تِجارَةَ كالعَملِ الصّالحِ، ولا رِبحَ كالثَّوابِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There is no [goods for] trade like good deeds, and no profit like the [divine] reward.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أربَحُ النّاسِ منِ اشْتَرى بالدُّنيا الآخِرَةَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The most profiting, among people, is the one who buys the Hereafter at the expense of this world.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ مَن باعَ نَفسَهُ بغيرِ الجَنّةِ فقد عَظُمَتْ علَيهِ المِحْنةُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever sells himself for [a price] less than Paradise, his ordeal is indeed severe.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَنِ اتَّخَذَ طاعةَ اللّهِ بِضاعةً أتَتْهُ الأرْباحُ مِن غيرِ تِجارةٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever takes the obedience of Allah as a commodity will see profits without even trading.

_source.chapter: Trading Does Not Divert The Believer
_source.arabic: عن فقه الرضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا كُنتَ في تِجارَتِكَ وحَضَرَتِ الصّلاةُ فلا يَشغَلْكَ عنها مَتْجَرُكَ، فإنَّ اللّهَ وَصفَ قَوما ومدَحَهُم فقالَ: «رِجالٌ لا تُلهيهم تِجارَةٌ وَلاَ بَيْعٌ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللّهِ وَإِقامِ الصَّلاَةِ وَإِيتاءِ الزَّكاةِ يَخافُونَ يَوْما تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ القُلُوبُ وَالأبْصارُ» . وكانَ هؤلاءِ القَومُ يَتَّجِرونَ، فإذا حَضَرَتِ الصّلاةُ تَرَكوا تِجارَتَهُم وقاموا إلى صَلاتِهِم، وكانوا أعظَمَ أجْرا مِمَّن لا يَتَّجِرُ فيُصَلّي .
_source.english: It is narrated in Fiqh al-Ridha (AS): ‘When you are engaged in your trade and prayer time arrives, let not your trading divert you from it; for Allah described a certain people and praised them, saying, “Men whom neither trade nor sale can divert…” These people used to trade, but when prayer time arrived they would leave their trade and stand for their prayer. They deserved more reward than non-traders who prayed.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): المُسْتَأكِلُ بدِينِهِ حَظُّهُ مِن دِينِهِ ما يَأكُلُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever seeks to eat by sacrificing his religion will only have from his religion as much as he eats.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن طَلبَ الدُّنيا بعَملِ الآخِرَةِ كانَ أبْعَدَ لَهُ مِمّا طَلَبَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever seeks this world through the work of the Hereafter will have his goal set at a greater distance.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فِعلُ المَعروفِ ، وإغاثَةُ المَلهوفِ ، وإقراءُ الضُّيوفِ ، آلَةُ السِّيادَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Performing common acts of courtesy, bringing solace to a grief-stricken person, and being hospitable to guests is the instrument of leadership.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): المَعروفُ ذَخيرَةُ الأبَدِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Acts of courtesy are treasures for eternity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اعلَموا أنَّ المَعروفَ مُكِسبٌ حَمداً ، ومُعقِبٌ أجراً ، فلَو رَأيتُمُ المَعروفَ رَجُلاً لَرَأيتُموهُ حَسَناً جَميلاً يَسُرُّ النّاظِرينَ ويَفوقُ العالَمينَ ، ولَو رَأيتُمُ اللُّؤمَ رَأيتُموهُ سَمِجاً قَبيحاً مَشوماً تَنفِرُ مِنهُ القُلوبُ وتُغَضُّ دُونَهُ الأبصارُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, ‘Know that acts of courtesy earn praiseworthy results, and end in rewardable gains. If you were to see acts of courtesy personified as a man, you would perceive him to be good and handsome, pleasing for people to behold and transcending all the worlds. And if you were to see acts of vileness personified, you would perceive an ugly, revolting, disfigured man, whom the hearts would be averse to and whom the eyes would turn away from in disgust.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أوَّلُ مَن يَدخُلُ الجَنَّةَ أهلُ المَعروفِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The first people to enter Paradise will be those who performed acts of common courtesy to others.'

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أهلُ المَعروفِ في الدّنيا هُم أهلُ المَعروفِ في الآخِرَةِ ؛ لأِنَّهُم في الآخِرَةِ تَرجَحُ لَهُمُ الحَسَناتُ ، فيَجودونَ بِها عَلى أهلِ المَعاصي .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The people who perform acts of courtesy in this world will be the same ones to perform them in the Hereafter, for verily in the Hereafter their scales will be so laden with their good deeds that they will be able to bestow them generously on the sinners [in order to assist them].

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الجوادُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أهلُ المَعروفِ إلَى اصطِناعِه أحوَجُ مِن أهلِ الحاجَةِ إلَيهِ ؛ لأِنَّ لَهُم أجرَهُ وفَخرَهُ وذِكرَهُ ، فمَهما اصطَنَعَ الرَّجُلُ مِن مَعروفٍ فإنَّما يَبدأ فيهِ بِنَفسِهِ ، فلا يَطلُبَنَّ شُكرَ ما صَنَعَ إلى نَفسِهِ مِن غَيرِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Jawad (AS) said, ‘People who perform acts of courtesy towards others benefit more from them than the receptors of their kindness, for verily they have the reward for them, the [rewarding feeling of] pride for having helped someone as well as a mention. So however much good a man may do for others, it ultimately always starts by benefiting himself, such that he never seeks thanks for the benefit incurred by himself through helping others.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Spreading Kindness to Both Good and Bad People
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): رَأسُ العَقلِ بَعدَ الدِّينِ التَّوَدُّدُ إلَى النّاسِ ، واصطِناعُ الخَيرِ إلى كُلِّ بَرٍّ وفاجِرٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The peak of good reason after religious devotion is treating people with love, and doing good to both good and bad people.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Spreading Kindness to Both Good and Bad People
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اصطَنِعِ الخَيرَ إلى مَن هُوَ أهلُهُ ، وإلى مَن هُوَ غَيرُ أهلِهِ ، فإن لَم تُصِبْ مَن هُوَ أهلُهُ فأنتَ أهلُهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Perform acts of courtesy to those who are worthy of them as well as those who are not worthy of them, and even if they have no effect on those who deserve them, you are at least worthy of [performing] them.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:2, p. 35, number:76

_source.chapter: Circulation of Good Acts From Hand to Hand
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن تَصَدَّقَ بِصَدَقَةٍ عَلى رَجُلٍ مِسكينٍ كانَ لَهُ مِثلُ أجرِهِ ، ولَو تَداوَلَها أربَعونَ ألفَ إنسانٍ ثُمّ وَصَلَت إلى مِسكينٍ كانَ لَهُم أجراً كامِلاً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who offers charity to a poor man gets the reward befitting the action, but if forty thousand people pass the same offering from hand to hand until it reaches the poor man, they all receive a complete reward for it.

_source.chapter: Circulation of Good Acts From Hand to Hand
_source.arabic: الإمام الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَو جَرَى المَعروفُ عَلى ثَمانينَ كَفّاً لاَُجِروا كُلُّهُم فيهِ ، مِن غَيرِ أن يُنقَصَ صاحِبُهُ مِن أجرِهِ شَيئاً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘If an act of charity [or courtesy] goes through eighty changes of hands, all of them receive the reward for it, without any decrease in the reward of the initiating good-doer.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Making Someone Feel Obliged for an Act of Courtesy
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أحْيِ مَعروفَكَ بِإماتَتِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Give life to your act of courtesy by killing it [i.e. by killing your expectation of receiving anything in return].

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Making Someone Feel Obliged for an Act of Courtesy
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا صُنِعَ إلَيكَ مَعروفٌ فَاذكُرْ ، إذا صَنَعتَ مَعروفاً فَانْسَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘If an act of courtesy is done unto you, then be sure to remember it, and if you do an act of courtesy unto someone else, then be sure to forget it.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Making Someone Feel Obliged for an Act of Courtesy
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِلاكُ المَعروفِ تَركُ المَنِّ بِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The yardstick [used to measure the goodness] of an act of courtesy is the absence of expectation accompanying it.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): استِتمامُ المَعروفِ أفضَلُ مِنِ ابتِدائهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Bringing a good act to completion is better than [merely] initiating it.

_source.arabic: الإمام عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن لَم يُرَبِّ مَعروفَهُ فقَد ضَيَّعَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘One who does not sustain his good action loses it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الصَّنيعَةُ لا تَتِمُّ صَنيعَةً عِندَ المُؤمِنِ لِصاحِبِها إلّا بِثَلاثَةِ أشياءَ: تَصغيرِها، وسَترِها، وتَعجيلِها ، فمَن صَغَّرَ الصَّنيعَةَ عِندَ المُؤمِنِ فقَد عَظَّمَ أخاهُ ، ومَن عَظَّمَ الصَّنيعَةَ عِندَهُ فقَد صَغَّرَ أخاهُ ، ومَن كَتَمَ ما أولاهُ مِن صَنيعِهِ فقَد كَرَّمَ فِعالَهُ ، ومَن عَجَّلَ ما وَعَدَ فقَد هَنِئَ العَطِيَّةَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘A good turn done to a fellow believer is not considered complete until accompanied by three things: underestimation of the act, concealing it, and hastening its completion. He who underestimates his good turn to a fellow believer has esteemed his brother highly indeed, whereas he who esteems his good turn to be great has deemed his brother to be insignificant. He who conceals the good turn that he has done has honored his action, and he who hastens to fulfill his promise takes pleasure in the gift too.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Holding Acts of Common Courtesy in Contempt
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تُحَقِّرَنَّ شَيئاً مِنَ المَعروفِ ، ولَو أن تَلقى أخاكَ ووَجهُكَ مَبسوطٌ إلَيهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Never hold any act of common courtesy in contempt, even simply meeting a fellow brother with a face displaying pleasure at seeing him.
_source.cited_from: Kanz al-Fawaid li al-Karajiki, volume:1, p. 212

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Holding Acts of Common Courtesy in Contempt
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَستَصغِر شَيئاً مِنَ المَعروفِ قَدَرتَ عَلَى اصطِناعِه إيثاراً لِما هُوَ أكثَرُ مِنهُ ؛ فإنَّ اليَسيرَ في حالِ الحاجَةِ إلَيهِ أنفَعُ لأِهلِهِ مِن ذلكَ الكَثيرِ في حالِ الغَناءِ عَنهُ ، واعمَلْ لِكُلِّ يَومٍ بِما فيهِ تَرشُدُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Never deem any act of common courtesy that you are able to carry out as insignificant in comparing it to a greater act, for verily the simple act performed when the need for it arises is more beneficial to its receptor than the great act for which there is no need. Perform for each day good acts that befit it and you will grow on the right course.

_source.chapter: The Mark of Acceptance of a Good Act
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): خَيرُ المَعروفِ ما اُصيبَ بِهِ الأبرارُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The best act of common courtesy is that which good people are able to benefit from.

_source.chapter: The Mark of Acceptance of a Good Act
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سُئلَ عَن عَلامَةِ قَبولِ العَبدِ عِندَ اللّهِ ـ: عَلامَةُ قَبولِ العَبدِ عِندَ اللّهِ أن يُصيبَ بِمَعروفِهِ مَواضِعَهُ ، فإن لَم يَكُن كذلكَ فلَيسَ كذلكَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) was once asked what the mark of acceptance of a servant with Allah is, to which he replied, ‘The mark of acceptance of a servant with Allah is that his good acts reach the objects of their intention. If not, then that is not the case.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن قادَ ضَريراً أربَعينَ خُطوَةً عَلى أرضٍ سَهلَةٍ ، لا يَفي بِقَدرِ إبرَةٍ مِن جَميعِهِ طِلاعُ الأرضِ ذَهَباً ، فإن كانَ فيما قادَهُ مَهلَكَةٌ جَوَّزَهُ عَنها وَجَدَ ذلكَ في ميزانِ حَسَناتِهِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ أوسَعَ مِنَ الدّنيا مِائةَ ألفِ مَرَّةٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who leads a blind man forty steps on level ground, even if he was to be rewarded the whole worlds worth of gold, it would not be enough to recompense a needles worth of what that act deserves. And if there is a danger on the path which he averts him from, he will find that act on the Day of Resurrection within his balance of good deeds, larger than one hundred thousand times the expanse of the earth.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): دَخَلَ عَبدٌ الجَنَّةَ بِغُصنٍ مِن شَوكٍ كانَ عَلى طَريقِ المُسلِمينَ فأماطَهُ عَنهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘A servant [of Allah] entered Paradise because of a thorn branch that he removed from the path of fellow Muslims.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن بَنى عَلى ظَهرِ الطَّريقِ ما يَأوي عابِرَ سَبيلٍ بَعَثَهُ اللّهُ يَومَ القِيامَةِ عَلى نَجيبٍ مِن دُرٍّ ، ووَجهُه يُضيءُ لأِهلِ الجَنَّةِ نوراً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who builds a structure on the road affording shelter to a traveller, Allٍah will raise him on the Day of Resurrection mounted on a fine-bred camel made of pearls, and his face will radiate light for all the dwellers of Paradise.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن رَدَّ عَن قَومٍ مِنَ المُسلِمينَ عادِيةَ ماءٍ أو نارٍ وَجَبَت لَهُ الجَنَّةُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who averts an impediment of water or fire from a group of Muslims becomes deserving of obligatory entrance into Paradise.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رَأيتُ المَعروفَ كَاسمِهِ، ولَيسَ شَيءٌ أفضَلَ مِنَ المَعروفِ إلّا ثَوابَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘I have witnessed the act of common courtesy to be exactly as its name suggests, and nothing excels the act of common courtesy than its own reward.

_source.chapter: The Enjoinment of Compassion Towards One Another
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الراحِمونَ يَرحَمُهُم الرّحمنُ تباركَ وتعالى ، اِرحَمُوا مَن في الأرضِ يَرحَمْكُم مَن في السماءِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The All-Merciful, Blessed and most High, has mercy on those who are merciful (towards others). Have mercy on the dwellers of the earth and the [Lord of the] Heavens will have mercy on you.

_source.chapter: The Enjoinment of Compassion Towards One Another
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يُنادِي مُنادٍ في النارِ: يا حَنّانُ يا مَنّانُ نَجِّني مِنَ النارِ ، فَيَأْمُرُ اللّهُ مَلَكاً فَيُخرِجُهُ حتّى يَقِفَ بينَ يَدَيهِ ، فيقولُ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ: هل رَحِمتَ عُصفوراً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'One of the inmates of the Fire will call out: O Affectionate One, O Liberal Giver, save me from the Fire. So Allah will command one of His angels to take him out that he may come and stand before Him, and Allah will ask him, 'Were you ever compassionate towards a sparrow?'

_source.chapter: The Enjoinment of Compassion Towards One Another
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إرحَمْ تُرحَمْ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Have mercy and you will be had mercy upon.

_source.chapter: The Enjoinment of Compassion Towards One Another
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَجِبتُ لِمَن يَرجُو رَحمَةَ مَن فَوقَهُ كيفَ لا يَرحَمُ مَن دُونَهُ؟!
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'How I wonder at the one who hopes for the mercy of the One above him and yet himself does not have mercy on the one below him.

_source.chapter: Those That Are Most Deserving of Compassion
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اِرحَمُوا عَزيزاً ذَلَّ ، وغَنِيّا افتَقَرَ ، وعالِماً ضاعَ في زمانِ جُهّالٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Be compassionate towards a mighty person who has been dishonoured, a rich man who has become poor, and a scholar who has been forgotten amidst a generation of ignorant people.

_source.chapter: Those That Are Most Deserving of Compassion
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِرحَمِ المَساكينَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Be compassionate towards the destitute.

_source.chapter: Those That Are Most Deserving of Compassion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِرحَمْ مِن أهلِكَ الصَّغيرَ ووَقِّرْ مِنهُمُ الكَبيرَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Show compassion to the young in your family and reverence to the old.

_source.arabic: الخضرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في وَصِيَّتِهِ لِموسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: يَابنَ عِمرانَ، لا تُعَيِّرَنَّ أحَداً بِخَطيئَةٍ، وَابكِ عَلى خَطيئَتِكَ.
_source.english: al-Khizr (AS), in his advice to Prophet Moses (AS) said, ‘O son of AImran, do not ever condemn somebody for a mistake, and cry over your own mistake [instead].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن عَيَّرَ أخاهُ بِذَنبٍ قَد تابَ مِنهُ لَم يَمُتْ حَتّى يَعمَلَهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The one who condemns a fellow brother for a sin that he has already repented for will not die before committing it himself.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أذاعَ فاحِشَةً كانَ كمُبتَدِئها، ومَن عَيَّرَ مُؤمِناً بِشَيءٍ لَم يَمُتْ حَتّى يَركَبَهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The one who exposes someone s monstrous deed is as the one who initiated it, and the one who condemns a believer for something will not die before becoming guilty of it himself.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا زَنَت خادِمُ أحَدِكُم فَلْيَجلِدْها الحَدَّ ولا يُعَيِّرْها.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘If one of your servants commits adultery, lash her with the prescribed punishment but do not shame her.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إن عَيَّرَكَ أخوكَ المُسلِمُ بِما يَعلَمُ فيكَ فَلا تُعَيِّرْهُ بِما تَعلَمُ فيهِ؛ يَكونُ لَكَ أجراً وعَلَيهِ إثماً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘If your Muslim brother condemns you for whatever he knows about you, then do not condemn him back for whatever you know about him. You will have a reward whereas he will carry a sin.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما مِن إنسانٍ يَطعَنُ في عَينِ مُؤمِنٍ إلّا ماتَ بِشَرِّ ميتَةٍ، وكانَ قَمِنا أن لا يَرجِعَ إلى خَيرٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Anybody who discredits a believer s self-esteem will die an evil death, and he becomes deserving of never again returning to a good end.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أنَّبَ مُؤمِناً أنَّبَهُ اللّهُ فِي الدّنيا والآخِرَةِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who reviles a believer will be reviled by Allah in both this world and the Hereafter.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تُبدي الشَّماتَةَ لِأخيكَ فيَرحَمَهُ اللّهُ ويُصَيِّرَها بِكَ . مَن شَمَتَ بِمُصيبَةٍ نَزَلَت بِأخيهِ لَم يَخرُجْ مِنَ الدّنيا حَتّى يُفتَتَنَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Do not express malicious gloating at your brother [for a sin or misfortune] for Allah will have mercy on him as a result and make it befall you instead. He also said, ‘He who gloats over an affliction that has befallen his brother will not leave this world until he has been tried similarly.

_source.chapter: Condoling with one who is Grief-Stricken
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن عَزّى مُصاباً كانَ لَهُ مِثلُ أجرِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever condoles with a grief-stricken person receives the same reward as him [The reward of the grief-stricken is for their endurance of their pain (ed.)].

_source.chapter: Condoling with one who is Grief-Stricken
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن عَزَّى الثَّكلى أظَلَّهُ اللّهُ في ظِلِّ عَرشِهِ يَومَ لا ظِلَّ إلّا ظِلُّهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever condoles with a mother bereaved of her child will be shaded by Allah by the shade of His Throne on the Day when no other shade will avail.

_source.chapter: Condoling with one who is Grief-Stricken
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كَفاكَ مِنَ التَّعزِيَةِ بأن يَراكَ صاحِبُ المُصيبَةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The minimum condolence required of you is that the bereaved one sees you present.

_source.chapter: What to Say When Giving Condolences to a Grief-Stricken Person
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ رَسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) إذا عَزّى قالَ: آجَرَكُمُ اللّهُ ورَحِمَكُم ، وإذا هَنَّأ قالَ: بارَكَ اللّهُ لَكُم وبارَكَ عَلَيكُم.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) narrated that when the Prophet (SAWA) gave condolences, he would say, ‘May Allah recompense you and have mercy on you, and that when he gave congratulations, he would say, ‘May Allah bless you and send blessings on you.

_source.chapter: Congratulating the Grief-Stricken is More Appropriate than Condoling Him
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في تَعزِيَتِهِ لِلحَسَنِ بنِ سَهلٍ ـ: التَّهنِئَةُ بِآجِلِ الثَّوابِ أولى مِن التَّعزِيَةِ عَلى عاجِلِ المُصيبَةِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, when giving condolences to al-Hasan b. Sahl, ‘Congratulating someone for the reward that is in store for them is more appropriate than condoling them for a transient affliction.

_source.chapter: Allahs Hand Is With The Congregation
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أيُّها النّاسُ، علَيكُم بالجَماعةِ، وإيّاكُم والفُرْقةَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘O people, stay with the congregation and stay away from division.

_source.chapter: Allahs Hand Is With The Congregation
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يدُ اللّهِ على الجَماعةِ، فإذا اشْتَذَّ الشّاذُّ مِنهُم اخْتَطَفَهُ الشّيطانُ كما يَخْتَطِفُ الذِّئبُ الشّاةَ الشّاذّةَ مِن الغَنَمِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allahs Hand [i.e. divine aid] is with the congregation. Whenever a straying individual deviates, Satan snatches him up like a wolf snatches a sheep starying from the herd.

_source.chapter: Allahs Hand Is With The Congregation
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يدُ اللّهِ معَ الجَماعةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allahs Hand [i.e. divine aid] is with the congregation.

_source.chapter: Allahs Hand Is With The Congregation
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الجَماعةُ رَحمَةٌ والفُرْقَةُ عَذابٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Congregation [upon the truth] is a mercy and division is chastisement.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ وقد سُئلَ: ما جَماعةُ اُمّتِكَ ؟ ـ: مَن كانَ على الحقِّ وإنْ كانوا عَشرَةً .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA), when asked, ‘Who are the congregation of your community?, replied, ‘Those who are with the truth, even if they are but ten people.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ وقد سُئلَ عن تفسيرِ السُّنّةِ والبِدْعةِ والجَماعةِ والفُرْقةِ ـ: السُّنَّةُ ـ واللّهِ ـ سُنّةُ محمّدٍ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ)، والبِدعَةُ ما فارَقَها، والجَماعةُ ـ واللّهِ ـ مُجامَعَةُ أهلِ الحقِّ وإنْ قَلُّوا، والفُرْقةُ مُجامَعَةُ أهلِ الباطلِ وإنْ كَثُروا .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS), when asked to explain the terms: sunna [Prophetic practice], innovation, congregation and division, said, ‘By Allah, the sunna is the tradition of Muhammad (SAWA); innovation is anything that deviates from it; the congregation is the gathering of people who are with the truth, even if they are few in number; and division is the dissention of people who are with falsehood, even if they be many in number.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ظَنُّ الرَّجُلِ على قَدرِ عَقلِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A mans conjecture is proportionate to the extent of his reason.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ظنُّ العاقِلِ أصَحُّ مِن يَقينِ الجاهِلِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘An intellectual mans conjecture is sounder than an ignorant mans certainty.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اتَّقُوا ظُنُونَ المُؤمِنِينَ؛ فإنَّ اللّهَ تعالى جَعَلَ الحَقَّ على ألسِنَتِهم.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Be wary of the opinions given by believers, for verily Allah has made the truth flow from their tongues.

_source.chapter: Look for the Best in Any Situation Involving a Fellow Brother
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اُطلُبْ لأِخِيكَ عُذرا، فَإنْ لَم تَجِدْ لَهُ عُذراً فَالتَمِسْ لَهُ عُذراً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Make an excuse for your fellow brother, and even if you do not have an excuse [for his behaviour], then seek out an excuse for him.

_source.chapter: Look for the Best in Any Situation Involving a Fellow Brother
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ضَعْ أمرَ أخيكَ على أحسَنِهِ حتّى يَأتِيَكَ مِنهُ ما يَغلِبُكَ، ولا تَظُنَّنَّ بكَلِمَةٍ خَرَجَت مِن أخيكَ سُوءاً وأنتَ تَجِدُ لَها في الخَيرِ مَحمِلاً .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘See the best in any situation involving a fellow brother, until you experience something from him which proves you wrong, and do not assume the worst about something that your brother may say if you can find the possibility for good therein.

_source.chapter: The Virtue in Entertaining Good Opinions
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): حُسنُ الظَّنِّ راحَةُ القَلبِ وسَلامةُ الدِّينِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Entertaining good opinions is a comfort to the heart and [indicates] soundness of faith.

_source.chapter: The Virtue in Entertaining Good Opinions
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): حُسنُ الظَّنِّ يُخَفِّفُ الَهمَّ ، ويُنجي من تَقَلُّدِ الإثمِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Entertaining good opinions reduces anxiety, and saves one from being taken over by sin.

_source.chapter: The Virtue in Entertaining Good Opinions
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن حَسُنَ ظَنُّهُ بِالناسِ حازَ مِنهُمُ المَحَبَّةَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who thinks the best of people gains their love.

_source.chapter: The Virtue in Entertaining Good Opinions
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ الوَرَعِ حُسنُ الظَّنِّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The best of piety is to think the best of people.

_source.chapter: Caution against Entertaining Low or Suspicious Opinions
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إيّاكُم والظَّنَّ؛ فإنَّ الظَّنَّ أكذَبُ الكَذِبِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Beware of suspicion for verily suspicion is the worst of all lies.

_source.chapter: Caution against Entertaining Low or Suspicious Opinions
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا ظَنَنتُم فلا تُحَقِّقُوا، وإذا حَسَدتُم فلا تَبغُوا، وإذا تَطَيَّرتُم فَامضُوا .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘If you have assumed the worst [about someone or something], then do not seek to make it true. And if you are jealous [of someone or something] then do not covet them, and if you draw an evil omen from something, ignore it and walk away.

_source.chapter: Caution against Entertaining Low or Suspicious Opinions
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ البُخلَ والجُبنَ والحِرصَ غَرائزُ شَتّى يَجمَعُها سُوءُ الظَّنِّ بِاللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) wrote in his letter to al-Ashtar when he appointed him governor of Egypt, ‘Verily miserliness, cowardice and greed are all evil impulses brought together by entertaining a low opinion of Allah.

_source.chapter: Caution against Entertaining Low or Suspicious Opinions
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا إيمانَ مَع سُوءِ الظَّنِّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There is no room for faith with suspicion.

_source.chapter: Caution against Entertaining Low or Suspicious Opinions
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سُوءُ الظَّنِّ يُفسِدُ الاُمورَ ويَبعَثُ على الشُّرورِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Suspicion corrupts matters and gives rise to evils.

_source.chapter: Caution against Entertaining Low or Suspicious Opinions
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إيّاكَ أن تُسِيءَ الظَّنَّ؛ فإنّ سُوءَ الظَّنِّ يُفسِدُ العِبادَةَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Beware of entertaining suspicious thoughts for verily suspicion corrupts worship.

_source.chapter: Caution against Entertaining Low or Suspicious Opinions
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الشِّرِّيرُ لا يَظُنُّ بِأحَدٍ خَيرا؛ لأنّهُ لا يَراهُ إلّا بِطَبعِ نَفسِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The evil person cannot think well of anybody because he can only see people as he himself is predisposed.

_source.chapter: Avoiding That Which Incites Suspicious Thoughts
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن وَقَّفَ نفسَهُ مَوقِفَ التُّهَمَةِ فلا يَلُومَنَّ مَن أساءَ بهِ الظَّنَّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who stands in a suspect place cannot blame anyone for thinking suspiciously of him.

_source.chapter: Avoiding That Which Incites Suspicious Thoughts
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن دَخَلَ مَداخِلَ السَّوءِ اتُّهِمَ، مَن عَرَّضَ نَفسَهُ للتُّهَمَةِ فلا يَلُومَنَّ مَن أساءَ بهِ الظَّنَّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who enters bad places naturally stands to be accused, and the one who exposes himself to accusation cannot blame anyone for thinking suspiciously of him.

_source.chapter: Avoiding That Which Incites Suspicious Thoughts
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مُجالَسَةُ الأشرارِ تُورِثُ سُوءَ الظَّنِّ بِالأخيارِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Sitting in the company of bad people engenders suspicious thoughts about good people.

_source.chapter: Avoiding That Which Incites Suspicious Thoughts
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أسوَأُ النَّاسِ حالاً مَن لَم يَثِقْ بَأحَدٍ لِسُوءِ ظَنِّهِ، ولَم يَثِقْ بهِ أحَدٌ لِسُوءِ فِعلِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The person in the worst state is the one who does not trust anybody because of his suspiciousness, and who is not trusted by anybody because of his evil actions.

_source.chapter: Avoiding That Which Incites Suspicious Thoughts
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن لَم يَحسُنْ ظَنُّهُ استَوحَشَ مِن كُلِّ أحَدٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The one who does not think well of people feels alienated from everybody.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اِحتَرِسُوا مِنَ النَّاسِ بسُوءِ الظَّنِّ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Guard yourselves against people with suspicion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا استَولَى الصَّلاحُ على الزَّمانِ وأهلِهِ ثُمّ أساءَ رَجُلٌ الظَّنَّ برَجُلٍ لَم تَظهَرْ مِنهُ حَوبَةٌ فقد ظَلَمَ، وإذا استَولى الفَسادُ على الزَّمانِ وأهلِهِ فَأحسَنَ رَجُلٌ الظَّنَّ برجُلٍ فَقَد غَرَّرَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘At a time when good prevails over an era and among its people, if a man suspects another person who has never been seen committing an offence, then he has indeed wronged him. And when corruption prevails over an era and among its people, if a man assumes the best about somebody, then he has indeed jeopardised himself.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا كانَ الجَورُ أغلَبَ مِنَ الحَقِّ لَم يَحِلَّ لأحَدٍ أن يَظُنَّ بأحَدٍ خَيرا حتّى يَعرِفَ ذلكَ مِنهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘At a time when injustice is more prevalent than good, it is not permitted for anyone to entertain good opinions about another unless he knows him to be such.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ أعجَلَ الخَيرِ ثَواباً صِلةُ الرَّحِمِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Verily the good deed to be rewarded the fastest is reconciliation with one's kin.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سِرْ سَنَةً صِلْ رَحِمَكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If you want to be happy the whole year, reconcile with your kin.

_source.chapter: The Benefits of Maintaing Relations With Ones Kin
_source.arabic: فاطمةُ الزَّهراءُ (عَلَيهَا الّسَلامُ): فَرَضَ اللّهُ صِلَةَ الأرحامِ مَنماةً لِلعدَدِ.
_source.english: Fatima al-Zahra (AS) said, 'Allah made the maintenance of relations with one's kin obligatory in order to maintain growth in population.

_source.chapter: The Benefits of Maintaing Relations With Ones Kin
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن سَرَّهُ أن يُنسَأ في أجَلِهِ ، ويُزادَ في رِزقِهِ ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, 'Whoever would like an increase in his lifespan and in his sustenance should maintain relations with his kin.

_source.chapter: The Benefits of Maintaing Relations With Ones Kin
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): صِلَةُ الأرحامِ تُزَكِّي الأعمالَ وتُنْمِي الأموالَ ، وتَدفَعُ البَلوى ، وتُيَسِّرُ الحِسابَ وتُنسِئُ في الأجَلِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Maintaining relations with one's kin purifies one's actions, brings about an increase in wealth, repels misfortunes, eases the account [on the Day of Resurrection], and delays one's appointed time of death.

_source.chapter: The Benefits of Maintaing Relations With Ones Kin
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): صلةُ الأرحامِ تُحَسِّنُ الخُلُقَ وتُسَمِّحُ الكَفَّ وتُطَيِّبُ النَّفْسَ ، وتَزِيدُ في الرّزقِ وتُنسِئُ في الأجَلِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Maintaining relations with one's kin improves one's character, brings about open-handedness and cheerfulness, increases in one's sustenance, and delays one's appointed time of death.

_source.chapter: The Benefits of Maintaing Relations With Ones Kin
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الهاديُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَمّا كَلَّمَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ موسى ابنَ عِمرانَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) قالَ موسى: إلهي ... ما جَزاءُ مَن وَصَلَ رَحِمَهُ ؟ قالَ: يا موسى، أنسَأُ لَهُ أجَلَهُ، واُهَوِّنُ علَيهِ سَكَراتِ المَوتِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Hadi (AS) said, 'When Allah allowed [Prophet] Moses son of Amran (AS) to converse with Him, Moses (AS) asked, 'My God, what is the reward of one who maintains relations with his kin? He replied, 'O Moses, I delay the appointed time of his death, and ease the pangs of death for him.

_source.chapter: Reconciling With One Who Cuts You Off
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَقطَعْ رَحِمَكَ وإن قَطَعَتكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Do not cut off your kin even if they cut you off.

_source.chapter: Reconciling With One Who Cuts You Off
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ أوصَلَ الناسِ مَن وَصَلَ مَن قَطَعَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, 'The best reconciler is he who reconciles with one who cut him off.

_source.chapter: Caution against Cutting Ties With One's Kin
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ الملائكةَ لا تَنزِلُ على قَومٍ فيهِم قاطِعُ رَحِمٍ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Verily divine mercy does not spread over a people if among them lives one who has cut ties with his kin.

_source.chapter: Caution against Cutting Ties With One's Kin
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا قَطَعُوا الأرحامَ جُعِلَتِ الأموالُ في أيدِي الأشرارِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'If they cut off ties with their kin, their wealth will be placed at the disposal of evil people.

_source.chapter: Caution against Cutting Ties With One's Kin
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الذُّنوبُ التي تُعَجِّلُ الفَناءَ قَطيعَةُ الرَّحِمِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'The sin that hastens one's death is cutting off ties with one's kin.

_source.chapter: The Least One Can Do To Maintain Relations With One's Kin
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): صِلُوا أرحامَكُم ولو بِالسَّلامِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Maintain relations with your kin even if it be with a mere greeting (salam).

_source.chapter: The Least One Can Do To Maintain Relations With One's Kin
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): صِلْ رَحِمَكَ ولو بِشَربَةٍ مِن ماءٍ، وأفضَلُ ما تُوصَلُ بهِ الرَّحِمُ كَفُّ الأذى عَنها.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Maintain relations with your kin even if it be by offering them a drink of water. The best way to maintain relations is to refrain from hurting them in any way.

_source.chapter: That Which Corrupts People in General, sin
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ المَعصيَةَ إذا عَمِلَ بها العَبدُ سِرّاً لم تَضُرَّ إلّا عامِلَها، وإذا عَمِلَ بها عَلانِيَةً ولم يُغَيَّرْ علَيهِ أضَرَّت بالعامَّةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘If a servant [of Allah] was to secretly sin, he would only harm himself, and if he was to commit it openly and not change, people would be harmed by it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): وأيمُ اللّهِ، ما اختَلَفَت اُمَّةٌ بَعدَ نَبِيِّها إلّا ظَهَرَ باطِلُها على حَقِّها إلّا ماشاءَاللّهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘By Allah, no sooner does a community dissent after their prophet than falsehood prevails over the truth, save that which Allah wills…

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لن تُقَدَّسَ اُمّةٌ لايُؤخَذُ للضَّعيفِ فيها حَقُّهُ مِن القَوِيِّ غيرَ مُتَعتَعٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘A community who does not let the weak uphold his rights from the strong without obstacle will never be sanctified.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): صِنفانِ مِن اُمَّتي إذا صَلُحا صَلُحَت اُمَّتي، وإذا فَسَدا فَسَدَت اُمَّتي، قيلَ: يا رسولَ اللّهِ، ومَن هُما ؟ قالَ: الفُقَهاءُ والاُمَراءُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There are two kinds of people from my community who if they are sound [of faith] my community will be sound, and if they are corrupt my community will become corrupt. The Prophet was asked, ‘And who are they O messenger of Allah? He replied, ‘The jurists and the leaders.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِن الفَسادِ (المَفسَدَةِ) إضاعَةُ الزادِ، ومَفسَدَةُ المَعادِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily, from corruption comes the loss of sustenance.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِن الفَسادِ قَطعُ الدِّرهَمِ والدِّينارِ وطَرحُ النَّوى .
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘Of the things that are corruptive are blocking dirhams and dinars [i.e. blocking their circulation in society through hoarding] and relinquishing ones determination.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لولا عِبادٌ للّهِ رُكَّعٌ، وصِبيانٌ رُضَّعٌ، وبَهائمُ رُتَّعٌ، لَصُبَّ علَيكُمُ العَذابُ صَبّا .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Were it not for the praying servants of Allah, the young suckling children, and the grazing animals, punishment would pour down on you.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لو أنَّ الناسَ حينَ تَنزِلُ بِهِمُ النِّقَمُ، وتَزولُ عَنهُمُ النِّعَمُ، فَزِعُوا إلى رَبِّهم بِصِدقٍ مِن نِيّاتِهِم، وَوَلَهٍ مِن قُلوبِهِم، لَرَدَّ علَيهِم كُلَّ شارِدٍ، وأصلَحَ لَهُم كُلَّ فاسِدٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘If people were to fear and return to their Lord when calamities befall them and blessings are taken away from them, returning with truth in their intentions, and reverence in their hearts, He would return to them every runaway, and correct every corrupt person.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ اللّهَ (لَـ)يَدفَعُ بِمَن يُصَلِّي مِن شيعَتِنا عَمَّن لا يُصَلِّي مِن شِيعَتِنا ولو أجمَعُوا على تَركِ الصلاةِ لَهَلَكُوا، وإنَّ اللّهَ لَيَدفَعُ بمَن يُزَكِّي مِن شيعَتِنا عَمَّن لايُزَكِّي ... وهو قولُ اللّهِ عَزَّ وجلَّ: «ولَولا دَفعُ اللّهِ الناسَ بَعضَهُم بِبَعضٍ لَفَسَدَتِ الأَرضُ».
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Allah repels [corruption] from those of our followers who do not pray, with those of our followers who do pray, and if they were to all agree to not pray, they would be destroyed. And verily Allah repels [corruption] from those of our followers who do not pay the alms-tax with those of our followers who do pay the alms-tax. And this is the purport of Allahs verse in the Quran: “Were it not for Allah's repelling the people by means of one another, the earth would surely have been corrupted.” [Quran 2:251]

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الاستِشارةُ عَينُ الهِدايَةِ ، وقد خاطَرَ مَنِ استَغنى بِرَأيِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Seeking to consult someone [in ones affairs] is guidance in itself, and the one who suffices himself with his own opinion endangers himself.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا ظَهِيرَ كالمُشاوَرَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There is no better support than good counsel.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّما حُضَّ على المُشاوَرَةِ لأنّ رَأيَ المُشيرِ صِرْفٌ ، ورَأيَ المُستَشِيرِ مَشُوبٌ بالهَوى.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Seeking counsel has been highly emphasised because the opinion of the counselor is unadulterated whereas the opinion of the one seeking counsel is polluted with his own whims.

_source.chapter: People Whose Counsel Should Not Be Sought
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ للامام عليّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: يا عليُّ ، لا تُشاوِرْ جَباناً فإنّهُ يُضَيِّقُ علَيكَ المَخرَجَ ، ولا تُشاوِرِ البَخيلَ فإنّهُ يَقْصُرُ بكَ عن غايَتِكَ ، ولا تُشاوِرْ حَريصاً فإنّهُ يُزَيِّنُ لكَ شَرَهاً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘O Ali, do not seek counsel from a coward for verily he will confine the way out for you, nor from the miser for verily he will hold you back from your goal, and nor from the covetous one for verily he will make greediness fair-seeming to you.

_source.chapter: People Whose Counsel Should Not Be Sought
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَستَشِرِ الكَذّابَ ؛ فإنّهُ كالسَّرابِ: يُقَرِّبُ علَيكَ البَعيدَ ويُبَعِّدُ علَيكَ القَريبَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Do not seek counsel from a liar for verily he is like a mirage, he makes that which is far appear near, and he makes that which is near appear far.

_source.chapter: People Whose Counsel is Worthy of Being Sought
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ المَشورَةَ لا تكونُ إلّا بِحُدُودِها الأربَعةِ ... فأوَّلُها أن يكونَ الذي تُشاوِرُهُ عاقِلاً ، والثانيةُ أن يَكونَ حُرّاً مُتَدَيِّناً، والثالثةُ أن يكونَ صَديقاً مُواخِياً، والرابعةُ أن تُطلِعَه على سِرِّكَ فَيكونَ عِلمُهُ بهِ كَعِلمِكَ ثُمّ يُسِرَّ ذلكَ ويَكتُمَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Counsel should only be sought whilst fulfilling its four terms. Firstly that the one whose counsel you seek must be a man of intellect. Secondly that he must be a free and religious man. Thirdly, he must be brotherly and friendly, and fourthly that when you disclose your secret to him whereby he knows as much about it as you do, he would keep your secret and guard it well.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Guiding One Who Seeks Your Counsel
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): حَقُّ المُستَشيرِ إنْ عَلِمتَ أنَّ لَهُ رَأياً أشَرتَ علَيهِ ، وإن لَم تَعلَمْ أرشَدتَهُ إلى مَن يَعلَمُ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘The right of the one who seeks your counsel is that you point him in the right direction if you know that he is inclined towards a certain opinion, and if you do not know [which way to point out], then you must guide him to someone who does.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Guiding One Who Seeks Your Counsel
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَنِ استَشارَ أخاهُ فَلَم يَنصَحْهُ مَحْضَ الرَّأيِ سَلَبَهُ اللّهُ رَأيَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever seeks counsel from a fellow brother who refuses to advise him with even an opinion either way, Allah wrests him of his opinion.
